description: This file contains build definitions and custom build steps related to Chromium OS, particularly for device configuration, kernel partitioning, and bootloader customization within an OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Copies the target file to a temporary location, uses 'ptgen' to partition and copy kernel and rootfs, then cleans up temporary files.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Appends kernel image data to the specified image file using 'dd' with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Signs the kernel image with the Chrome OS vboot utility, replacing the original file with a signed version.

methods.name: Device/google_wifi
methods.description: Defines device-specific build parameters for Google's WiFi device based on IPQ4019 SoC, including kernel, images, and device packages.
